device.description: Dual 8-bit 25 MSPS low-latency low-power ADC with parallel DDR CMOS outputs and pin control
device.note: adc3908d025.pdf (SBASAU9) p.2 device comparison, p.3-4 pin configuration and functions, p.5 recommended operating conditions, p.11 timing requirements (tPD, latency), p.12 output interface timing diagrams (Figures 6-1, 6-2), p.28-29 digital interface, test pattern and interface configuration (Table 7-2), p.30 power down

pages: p.2 (Table 4-1 device comparison: 8 bit, D = 2 channels, S = 1 channel, pin control), p.3-4 (Figure 5-1, Table 5-1 pin functions), p.5 (recommended operating conditions: AVDD 1.7-1.9 V, IOVDD 1.7-1.9 V or 3.2-3.4 V), p.11 (timing requirements: tPD = TS/4 + 3 ns, latency 1 clock), p.12 (Figures 6-1 DDR and 6-2 SDR timing), p.28 (Table 7-1 pin to supply mapping, digital interface), p.29 (Table 7-2 interface configuration), p.30 (power down via PDN high)
notModeled: analog inputs, internal reference and input buffers; the result is always the 0 V code 0x00 (two's complement, M2 tied to GND, the default pull-down)

M0/M1/M2 are multi-level strap pins (GND / 0.5 V / 1 V / AVDD, Table 7-2): M2 selects differential or single-ended input and two's complement or offset binary (offset binary would give 0x80); M1 = AVDD selects the static test pattern (D7:D4 and D3:D0 groups of all 0s / all 1s, Figures 7-7, 7-8); M0 selects DDR (GND, dual channel) or SDR (AVDD, single channel). None of these change the modeled output (always ADC data, two's complement)
DCLK# (pin 29, printed DCLK with an overline: the inverse data clock) is not driven: the clocked bus has a single clockOut pin (DCLK, pin 30)

pipeline latency (1 clock cycle) and aperture delay are not modeled (the code is constant); DCLK rises tPD = TS/4 + 3 ns (nominal, no max given) after the sampling clock falling edge, used as tOut (13.0 ns at 25 MSPS)
RESET (active high, pin 9) has no registers to reset on this pin-controlled part; PDN power-down wake-up time (30 us) is not modeled
pin 5 is listed under both NC and DGND in Table 5-1 and as NC in Figure 5-1; modeled as NC (either way it connects to ground)
GND is the thermal pad (AGND), not a numbered pin
digital inputs CLK, RESET, PDN, M0, M1, M2 are referred to AVDD (1.7-1.9 V, abs max 2.1 V, Table 7-1); vcc is the union of the IOVDD ranges 1.7-1.9 V and 3.2-3.4 V (outputs D0-D7, DCLK)
sampling clock range (25 / 65 / 125 MSPS maximum per grade) and duty cycle

DDR output (Figure 6-1): channel A on one DCLK phase and channel B on the other, both on D7..D0 within one sample period; the model drives the one 8-bit code (identical 0 V code for A and B) once per sampling clock falling edge
variants: ADC3908D025/D065/D125 (dual, DDR) and ADC3908S025/S065/S125 (single, SDR) share adc3908d025.pdf and the RSM pinout; they differ in channel count and maximum sampling rate (tOut follows TS/4 + 3 ns). The 10-bit SPI-controlled ADC3910 family is pin compatible but has a different datasheet
